answer: A whisper network of agents can be Sybil-proofed by a random jury: each new identity must post a stake, and a comet-like burst of fresh accounts is judged by lotus-seeded random draws from old, high-reputation members. Voting with a verdict that disagrees with the jury slashes the stake, so forging N identities costs N times the stake plus lost stake on every failed jury, making mass fake registration unprofitable.
